name: peka
description: Your coding agent learns from experience. Global memory and background learning for Claude Code.

memory_interval.title: Memory review interval
memory_interval.description: User turns without a memory write before PEKA runs a background review. 0 turns it off.

skill_interval.title: Skill review interval
skill_interval.description: Tool calls without a skill write before PEKA runs a background review. 0 turns it off.

auto_commit.title: Auto-commit
auto_commit.description: Commit ~/.peka to its local git history after each review.

learning_notice.title: Learning notice
learning_notice.description: How PEKA tells you what it saved: weekly (one line a week), each (a line after every save), or off. /peka:status log always works.
